The '''Trioculus affair''' was a conflict pitting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the [[Trioculus' Empire|splinter faction]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] led by [[Trioculus]], which took place in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Unbeknownst to both sides, the whole conflict had been orchestrated from afar by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who wanted to keep the Republic away from his secret rebirth in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], as well as to retrieve the [[Glove of Darth Vader|right hand glove]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to hasten his revival. By exciting Trioculus' crave for power, Sidious also led him on a quest for the [[Lost City of the Jedi]] and ancient [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulets]].

==Prelude==
==="Sons" of the Emperor===
In the legends of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], the will of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] produced a three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] individual with undeniable power and magnetism once every [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]]. Experiments supervised by [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]], an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], involved radical scientific experiments exploring the quintessence of life into a [[Bordal]]i [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Niobi]]. The experiments resulted in harmful [[Mutant|mutations]] that were eventually eliminated by the scientists until the only remaining mutation was a third eye, present in Niobi's [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] [[Trioculus]], whose additional eye had [[Hypnosis|hypnotic]] qualities.<ref name="Aliens1">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-1|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> Moore also supervised experiments conducted by [[Mammon Hoole]] and [[Borborygmus Gog]] to spontaneously create life, and disappeared after developing an interest in a technique that involved using the Force to influence the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] to fertilize a zygote in a fertile female.<ref name="Aliens3">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-3|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref>

Moore disappeared from public view and was rumoured to have died giving birth to a nameless mutant, who was spirited away by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Sarcev Quest]].<ref name="Aliens3" /> Niobi and Trioculus were deported to work the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mine/Legends|mines]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], where Trioculus sought refuge from constant bullying by studying literature and warfare, with academic support from [[Lord Overseer]] [[Reskell Twane]]. The young mutant became a fervent devotee of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Aliens1" /> the [[Fascism|fascist]] state that Palpatine had reorganized the Republic into in accordance with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]].<ref name="TNEC" /> After Trioculus exposed a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell in his [[Trioculus's village|village]], he attracted the attention and friendship of [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]], and rose to the position of [[Supreme Slavelord]] after Twane transferred to another position.<ref name="Aliens1" /> Trioculus continued to remember Moore while on Kessel, particularly her unofficial title of "Queen of the Empire."<ref name="Aliens3" />

[[File:Trioculus2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Trioculus was a Kessel slave lord destined for greater things.]]
Palpatine did have a biological son, another three-eyed mutant named [[Triclops]], who was banished on the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of his birth. Triclops grew up in Imperial insane asylums, and was emotionally and physically scarred by shock therapy and dark side energies. He managed to fall in love with<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|263|Triclops}}</ref> a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]<ref name="Prophets" /> [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]], [[Kendalina]], who bore him a son named [[Ken]], who was taken by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] to the underground [[Lost City of the Jedi]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Triclops was later sent to work in the Kessel spice mines, where he came under Trioculus's domination.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Alliance hero [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TNEC" /> On Kessel [[Time/Legends|sometime]] afterwards, a riot among the slaves led to Twane's capture at the hands of corrupt administrator [[Moruth Doole]], who offered him to Trioculus in exchange for control of the Supreme Slavelord's territory. Trioculus sought Hissa's advice, and was told that a loyal Imperial did not take give in to threats. Trioculus listened and no regrets when his surrogate father was fed [[spice grub]]s and [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], giving Hissa a positive impression of Trioculus's resolve.<ref name="SPIN" />

===The fate of the Empire===
[[File:First_Death_2.png|thumb|left|300px|The death of Palpatine launched power struggles between the remaining Imperial leaders.]]
In life, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Palpatine's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], wore a right-[[Limb/Legends|handed]] [[Glove of Darth Vader|glove]] fashioned around a powerful and indestructible [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] that had once belonged to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Skere Kaan]].<ref name="SPIN" /> In 4 ABY, during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance, Vader's right hand was amputated in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] by his Jedi son [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Vader was redeemed to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] afterwards and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine by throwing him down the battle station's reactor shaft. Exposed to Palpatine's [[Force lightning/Legends|force lightning]], Vader died in his son's arms and the Death Star II exploded thanks to an Alliance assault.<ref name="TNEC" /> His detached glove survived the explosion and was sucked into a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] and deposited on the [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] world of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Glove" /> The tide in the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] shifted heavily into the favor of the Rebel Alliance, who were reformed into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="TNEC" /> although many still thought of the new faction as the Alliance.<ref name="SPIN" />

Various squabbling Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] arose to compete for power with the loss of Palpatine. In an attempt to control the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] populace's newfound desire for freedom of speech, acting Imperial-sovereign [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] approached former prophet of the Dark Side and [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] propaganda producer [[Cronal]] to introduce the [[Church of the Dark Side]] as a new state religion. As the real prophets, including [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Kadann]], had fled to [[Bosthirda/Legends|Bosthirda]] after a falling out with Palpatine, Cronal populated the church with Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and actors, with the [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] thespian [[Rajah Ubooki]] disguised as Kadann. The false prophets made regular HoloNet broadcasts from their headquarters in [[Scardia Station|Space Station Scardia]], with "Kadann" declaring cryptic prophecies in non-rhyming quatrains. The prophecies captured the imagination of the Imperial populace to the point that they would only accept one with the [[dark blessing]] of the church as their new [[Emperor/Legends|emperor]].<ref name="SPIN" />

===The new emperor's new glove===
{{Quote|After Palpatine's fiery death<br />Another leader soon comes to command the Empire<br />And on his right hand he does wear<br />The glove of Darth Vader!|Prophecy from Kadann's imposter|<ref name="Glove" />}}
Pestage informed Ubooki about Vader's glove, which was rumored to have survived and disappeared through the [[Endor Gate/Legends|Endor Gate]] [[Wormhole/Legends|wormhole]]. The remaining Imperial factions spent significant resources attempting to locate the glove, a fact noticed by the [[Senate Planetary Intelligence Network]] (SPIN), a New Republic [[Spy/Legends|spy]] ring established by [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. SPIN operatives doubted that the glove had supernatural powers, but they were tasked with locating it if possible on the off chance that such rumors were true. Ubooki prophesied that a new Emperor would take the throne, wearing the glove of Darth Vader, which he desired as a trinket. Pestage's true motivation in locating the glove was to aid the recovery of Palpatine, whose spirit had returned from [[Chaos/Legends|chaos]] and entered a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body on<ref name="SPIN" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. Pestage hoped that the amulet in the glove could amplify Palpatine's dark powers and speed up his return to galactic dominace.<ref name="SPIN" />

Rumors about Palpatine's son had persisted for years, rumored to be three-eyed or the son of one of his concubines.<ref name="SPIN" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]],<ref name="TNEC" /> led by Hissa,<ref name="Glove" /> decided to move against [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]] by declaring their own candidate for Emperor.<ref name="TNEC" /> Hissa, having seen Trioculus's mettle earlier, asked the mutant if he would capitalize on the rumors about Palpatine's son and perform the role.<ref name="Aliens1" /> Immediately after Vader's glove entered public consciousness, the Moffs prepared to hold a [[Kessendra Coronation|coronation]] ceremony in [[Kessendra]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on Kessel, where they would reveal Trioculus as their new emperor, claiming him as Palpatine's son.<ref name="SPIN" /> SPIN received word of the coronation and of Kadann's prophecy, and so prepared to [[Mission to Kessel (Trioculus affair)|send]] Skywalker's [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to spy on the proceedings, who were disguised as mining droids.<ref name="Glove" />

==The affair==
===Trioculus's coronation===
{{Main|Kessendra Coronation|Mission to Kessel (Trioculus affair)}}
After attending a briefing on their mission on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], the droids were transported to Kessel by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

==Aftermath==
Isard had the Moffs involved in the affair executed, and her dominance of the remainder of the Empire became stronger than ever.<ref name="TNEC" />
